TOP: GitLab CVSS 10.0 flaw allows unauthenticated RCE
Ghostscript PDF RCE and Racket signing keys leaked
Stolen AWS keys probed for Bedrock access

P.h: GitLab patches CVSS 10.0 flaw allowing unauthenticated code execution
P.p: CVE-2026-97229 is an integer overflow in regex validation for CI/CD configurations. Under certain conditions an unauthenticated user could execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server.
P.s: Fixes ship in CE/EE 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2, along with patches for high-severity XSS, authorization and response-cache poisoning bugs. Patch self-managed instances now.

items.h: Ghostscript flaw lets attackers hijack servers via PDF uploads
items.d: Wordfence found RCE via crafted PDFs. WordPress sites are exposed when uploaded PDFs are processed for previews or thumbnails. Other apps using Ghostscript may be too.

items.h: Racket build server breach exposes signing keys
items.d: A crypto miner on a compromised Northwestern build server leaked Apple and Windows signing keys. Both rotated; macOS users on 8.12 to 9.3 should reinstall.

items.h: Exposed AWS keys are probed for Bedrock access
items.d: Datadog saw harvesting platforms call ListFoundationModels, InvokeModel and Converse to test stolen credentials, and one script checked for promotional credits.

items.h: Trezor wallets found with hardware implants
items.d: Joe Grand found swapped microcontrollers running malicious firmware that showed pre-generated seed phrases, contradicting Trezor's public claim.

P.h: Workday to acquire C1.ai as identity for AI agents becomes a deal
P.p: Workday agreed to buy C1.ai, an agentic identity platform. The plan ties employee lifecycle events directly to app provisioning, permission changes and access removal across enterprise systems, for people and AI agents alike.
P.s: Broadcom also launched VMware HyperArmor: virtual patching, application allowlisting and hypervisor-level MFA for VMware Cloud Foundation, with no downtime or guest agents.

tiles.t: Microsoft takes Azure Maia to multi-gigawatt scale
tiles.d: From 2027 Maia becomes the primary inference system. Maia 300 targets long-context agentic tasks.
Connectivity Performance Suite blamed for OneDrive and OneNote drops.

tiles.t: Human PR review is next to go
tiles.d: AI-written code shifts QA to guardrails, review bots and acceptance tests.

tiles.t: AWS 'priming' cuts hybrid model pretraining cost 99%
tiles.d: Reuses Transformer weights for state space hybrids that decode up to twice as fast. Released under Apache 2.0.
Wait times fell from hours to minutes.

P.h: AWS Lambda Web Functions run ordinary HTTP apps without an event handler
P.p: Deploy existing Node.js servers built with Express or Next.js as they are. The service handles scaling and multi-region distribution, each environment takes up to 128 concurrent requests, and billing follows active CPU time.
P.s: It is available today in five regions. Separately, Google released a fully rewritten second edition of the SRE book, covering AI, microservices and platform engineering.

tiles.d: 2026 report: 69% CPU overprovisioning, GPUs at 2% on AKS. Requests are rarely revisited.

tiles.t: Cloudflare D1 scales to millions of DBs
tiles.d: Control plane kept off the query hot path.
New Relic's Ground Truth layer serves agents and humans.

tiles.t: Instagram Live moves to Media over QUIC
tiles.d: Replaces Meta's in-house RUSH with the IETF standard, matching quality and reliability in tests.

items.h: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon broadly available
items.d: Multimodal flagship now in the paid Gemini API, AI Studio and Antigravity, with limited-time low API pricing.

items.h: Anthropic replaces git with in-house Scion
items.d: Monorepo migrated in five months. Merges grew from about 2,500 to over 30,000 changes per day.

items.h: FBI arrests OpenAI engineer over office recording device
items.d: A hidden, encrypted audio recorder was found in an office. The suspect joined the product team in July 2025.

items.h: Apple HomeView: $299 tablet that recognizes six household members
items.d: Seven-inch countertop or wall-mounted device, on sale November 13.
